status: Planned next avenue; no experiment from this plan has run yet
purpose: Learn a supervised correction to a frozen foundation model without leaking outer-validation labels through ordinary OOF stacking
procedure: Choose the 50,000 context rows only from outer training using the recorded stratified context sampler.
Fit frozen Kumo or TabPFN on those context labels only.
Predict the 6,000 outer-training rows excluded from the context, the outer validation, and test.

Fit a regularized correction using the 6,000 excluded context rows and their labels. No outer-validation label or probability from a model trained on an outer-validation label is a correction-training input.
Evaluate the corrected predictions on the 14,000 outer-validation rows, then assemble all five OOF partitions.
initial_correction_families: Strongly regularized logistic model on foundation logit and prespecified raw/latent risk features
Small smooth EBM with foundation logit as an initial score, learning residual structure from context-holdout rows
audit_requirements: Context, correction-training and outer-validation IDs must be pairwise disjoint.
Context union correction-training must exactly equal outer training.
Save context/correction/validation ID hashes and every prediction-source hash.
No shared correction model may be trained using all-fold OOF labels and then evaluated on those same rows.
Any correction early stopping uses only the 6,000 correction-training rows.
selection_limitations: Research still reuses the existing training labels and outer splits. This design prevents direct outer-label leakage; it does not remove the optimism from repeated research.
